lines.text: Tell me, boy...
...what is it you want to break?
Everything that's in the way.
Two-fourteen. Last freight of the night.
Same crossing. Same bell.
Same cat.
It was Haruki's cat first. He fed it every night on his way home.
lines.tts: It was Hah-roo-kee's cat first. He fed it every night, on his way home.

lines.text: Two years now.
So I bring the cat food. Somebody has to.
Tuna. The expensive kind. Don't tell anyone.
Grandma used to say I was born to carry things for other people.
...What is it?
The bell... There's no train.
...Okay. No.
Don't come near it!
Hey!
Get down!
...Two moons.
Okay. That's new.
And I'm holding... an axe?
Where the hell am I?
Hnnnaaah... Oh. You're alive. Neat.
lines.tts: Hhaaaaah... Oh. You're alive. Neat.

lines.text: You were lying on train tracks a minute ago.
Mm. I'm very good at that.
Lying places. Getting squished.
Where is this?
The Barrow Fields. Edge of the Ashen March.
You fell out of the sky.
People like you have a name here. Skyfallen.
There are others?
A few. Most of them land worse.
...I'll take that as a compliment.
...Hey.
Where did you get that axe?
It was sticking out of a grave. I grabbed it on the way down.
That's the Headsman's Axe.
It's been stuck in that grave for three hundred years.
People tried pulling it out with horses.
...It was loose.
WHY WAS IT LOOSE?!
lines.tts: Why was it loose?!

lines.text: Rifts open in the sky. Things crawl out.
We call them Fiends.
Swords don't bite them. Arrows bounce off.
Normal people can't do anything but run.
Unless you have a Brand.
A mark on your soul. It wakes up when you're about to die... if you have one.
Branded people become Hunters. They hunt Fiends for the Guild.
And people without one?
Get very good at running.
Mine's called Nine Lives.
I can die nine times. I've used six.
Six.
Don't make the face.
I'm not making a face.
You're making it with your eyes.
That thing at the crossing. Was it chasing you?
I was digging for grave silver. It woke up. Shieldbearers don't wake up.
Then the ground opened. Rifts open in the sky... not into other worlds.
Somebody opened that one.
...You hear that?
A bell. There are no bells out here.
Run. I mean it this time.
You said that at the crossing.
And you didn't listen! I only have three left!
Then stay behind me.
Don't hit the shield! Nothing breaks the shield!
Then what do I hit?!
Nothing! We run!
Can't... get up...
Hey! Ugly!
Over here!
Wait!
Born to carry things for other people.
Groceries. Grudges. Blame.
Not this. I'm not carrying this one.
Finally.
Three hundred years in the dirt, and this is who pulls me out?
Who are you?
The reason the axe was stuck.
Tell me, boy. What is it you want to break?
Everything that's in the way.
...Good answer.
It was in the way.
Hnnaaah... Ow.
lines.tts: Hhaaaah... Ow.

lines.text: You were dead.
Mm. That's seven. Two left.
Don't do that again.
You're making the face.
I'm making it with my whole face this time.
...I never asked your name.
Nemu.
lines.tts: Neh-moo.

lines.text: And you're the idiot who pulled out the Headsman's Axe.
Takuto. Kirishima Takuto.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Kee-ree-shee-mah, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: Well, well, well.
A Shieldbearer's shield. Broken in one swing.
Twelve years I've been hunting. Never seen that.
Nice axe, kid. Mind telling me where you got it?
It was loose.
He keeps saying that.
Ha! It was loose, he says.
You two had better come with me. Because that...
...is not supposed to stay open.
We're going to have so much fun, you and I.
One fell through.
...Good.
Next time: the Hunters' Guild.
A test that reads my rank as ERROR...
lines.tts: A test that reads my rank as error...

lines.text: ...and a girl with a red scarf who hates me on sight.
Why does she have my hair?
Episode two. Branded.
My name is Takuto Kirishima. Seventeen. Nerima ward, Tokyo.
lines.tts: My name is Tah-koo-toh Kee-ree-shee-mah. Seventeen. Neh-ree-mah ward, Tokyo.

lines.text: I go to school. I sleep in class. I get into fights I do not start, and finish them anyway.
Two years ago, my best friend walked to the railway crossing to feed a stray cat, and never came home.
I still go every night. Somebody has to feed the cat.
Your knuckles are bleeding.
They started it.
There were three of them, and they are in high school, and you are fourteen. They definitely started it. You definitely finished it.
Why did you stop me?
Because they got it. You were just going to keep going. You looked like you would keep going forever.
...Nobody ever stops me.
Then I will. Haruki Shinjo. Class two-B. You are Kirishima, right? Everybody is scared of you.
lines.tts: Then I will. Hah-roo-kee Sheen-joh. Class two-B. You are Kee-ree-shee-mah, right? Everybody is scared of you.

lines.text: You are not.
I am terrified. I just hide it well. Hey, look. Behind the vending machine.
A cat. It watched the whole fight.
It looks hungry.
What do cats drink? Milk?
The machine only has coffee milk.
Then it is getting coffee milk. Terrible idea. Let us do it.
Ha! It likes it! It actually likes it!
It is making a face.
We should name it. I am calling it Mister Tuesday. I met it on a Tuesday.
That is a terrible name.
What would you call it?
...Coffee.
That is worse! That is so much worse!
Same time tomorrow? Somebody has to feed it.
...Same time tomorrow.
You are late. You are always late. The cat is going to give up on us.
Ten minutes. My dad caught me on the stairs.
Takuto. The sky looks weird tonight. Is it supposed to crackle like that?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. The sky looks weird tonight. Is it supposed to crackle like that?

lines.text: Crackle?
There is a crack in it. Takuto, there is a crack in the—
lines.tts: There is a crack in it. Tah-koo-toh, there is a crack in the—

lines.text: When I got there, there was a bag of cat food on the ground, and nobody else.
Takuto? Is that you? Out so late again?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh? Is that you? Out so late again?

lines.text: Mrs. Shinjo. You are putting up posters at one in the morning?
lines.tts: Mrs. Sheen-joh. You are putting up posters at one in the morning?

lines.text: The old ones get wet. Nobody reads a wet poster.
Two years. Nobody calls anymore. Not even the police.
I will help.
You always say that. You are a good boy, Takuto. He always said so.
lines.tts: You always say that. You are a good boy, Tah-koo-toh. He always said so.

lines.text: Are you still feeding the cat?
Every night.
Then he will know where to find you. When he comes back.
Go on. It is almost two. Do not keep it waiting.
...Good night, Mrs. Shinjo.
lines.tts: ...Good night, Mrs. Sheen-joh.

lines.text: Proper introductions, then. Sieg Valen. Hunter, rank A. Some people call me the Laughing Blade. I do not know why.
lines.tts: Proper introductions, then. Seeg Valen. Hunter, rank A. Some people call me the Laughing Blade. I do not know why.

lines.text: He winks a lot.
I wink exactly the right amount.
Takuto Kirishima. I fell out of the sky.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh Kee-ree-shee-mah. I fell out of the sky.

lines.text: I noticed. A Skyfallen. You came through a Rift. The crack you saw in your sky. They open over this world, and Fiends crawl out of them.
The skeleton with the shield.
A Skeletal Shieldbearer. Lesser class. The weakest Fiend you will ever meet. You just broke its shield, which nobody has ever done.
It was in the way.
Ha! It was in the way. I like you.
Ordinary weapons barely scratch a Fiend. To hurt one, you need a Brand. A power carved into your soul. It shows up as a mark.
It only wakes when you are close to death. When you want something so badly that dying is not enough to stop you.
The axe.
The axe woke yours. Or you woke the axe. I am not sure which yet.
Mine is Nine Lives. I can die nine times and get back up.
You died. Today. I watched you die.
Mm. That was number seven. Two left. Do not look so sad. It is a good Brand. Very practical.
...Two left.
Two is a lot. Most people only get one.
Sieg. How do I get home?
lines.tts: Seeg. How do I get home?

lines.text: Skyfallen do not go home, Takuto. Not that I have ever heard of. I am sorry.
lines.tts: Skyfallen do not go home, Tah-koo-toh. Not that I have ever heard of. I am sorry.

lines.text: My friend fell through two years ago. From the same crossing. Haruki Shinjo. Black hair. Blue eyes.
lines.tts: My friend fell through two years ago. From the same crossing. Hah-roo-kee Sheen-joh. Black hair. Blue eyes.

lines.text: Then he could be anywhere in this world. Or nowhere. The Hunters' Guild keeps records of every Skyfallen it finds.
Where is the Guild?
Ashford. Three days east. The frontier town. I am going there anyway. You two are coming with me.
Me?
You died for him, little cat. That makes you his problem now. And his problem is my problem. That is how it works.
So. You can hear me now, boy. Properly. Not just in the screaming.
Who are you?
The one in the axe. The one who asked you a question. Do you remember what I asked?
What is it you want to break.
And? You never really answered. You just swung. Very satisfying. Very rude.
I want to find Haruki.
lines.tts: I want to find Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: That is not breaking, boy. That is finding. Those are different verbs. Think about it. We have time. I have had three hundred years of it.
What is your name?
...Akuro. Remember it. Everyone else forgot.
lines.tts: ...Ah-koo-roh. Remember it. Everyone else forgot.

lines.text: You live here? In a graveyard?
I am a grave scavenger. I find nice things the dead do not need, and I sell them in town for bread.
That sounds illegal.
It is very illegal. But I ask them first. I always ask. If they say no, I leave it.
They say no?
Sometimes. You can feel it. A grave that says no feels heavy. Like a held breath.
The Headsman's grave always said no. For years. I tried to pull that axe out once. I hurt my back for a week.
It came out for me.
It said yes to you. I have never heard a grave say yes so loud.
Takuto. Thank you. For breaking the thing that was killing me.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Thank you. For breaking the thing that was killing me.

lines.text: You died anyway.
Only a little. You got there in time for the rest of me.
This is everything I own. A blanket. A spoon. A music box that plays half a song.
Half a song?
The other half is broken. Maybe you could break it back.
That is not how breaking works.
You do not know that yet.
Goodbye, everyone. I am going to Ashford. Do not let anyone else take your nice things while I am gone.
Takuto. Let me see the axe. Just look. I will not touch it.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Let me see the axe. Just look. I will not touch it.

lines.text: Three hundred years old. Older. Look at the marks on the haft.
This is the Headsman's Axe. The one from the stories.
What stories?
Stories you tell children so they stay out of graveyards. They mostly do not work. Ask Nemu.
lines.tts: Stories you tell children so they stay out of graveyards. They mostly do not work. Ask Neh-moo.

lines.text: Do not swing it at anything you love, Takuto. And if it ever talks to you, tell me.
lines.tts: Do not swing it at anything you love, Tah-koo-toh. And if it ever talks to you, tell me.

lines.text: ...Okay.
Liar. Ha. We are going to get along so well, boy.
How far is Ashford?
Three days.
Can you carry me for two of them?
Rank A Hunters do not carry cats.
I died yesterday.
...One day. I will carry you for one day.
Mm. Deal.
Is everything in this world trying to kill us?
Only most things. The rest are trying to sell you something.
Watch the treeline. Fiends like dusk. Ashen Hounds, mostly. Small. Mean. Afraid of fire.
I do not have fire.
You have an axe that broke something unbreakable. I think the Hounds will be very polite to you.
Takuto. What is your world like?
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. What is your world like?

lines.text: Loud. Bright. Too many people. Trains every three minutes.
What is a train?
A metal house that runs on rails. Very fast. You can sleep in it.
A house you can sleep in, that also takes you places? That is the best thing I have ever heard.
There are vending machines on every corner. Boxes that give you drinks at two in the morning.
For free?
For coins. One of them has coffee milk. That is where I fed the cat.
What is the cat called?
Coffee. Haruki wanted Mister Tuesday.
lines.tts: Coffee. Hah-roo-kee wanted Mister Tuesday.

lines.text: Mister Tuesday is a much better name.
...Everybody says that.
Who is feeding Coffee now?
...Nobody.
Then we had better find your friend quickly. Cats do not wait forever.
One. Two. Three...
Eleven. And now two more. Thirteen.
A Rift that opens sideways. A Skyfallen boy with the Headsman's Axe. And static in the air, like before Grey Hollow.
...I do not like this at all.
